title: Tanker Markets at Two Chokepoints
summary:
Main
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-11-18 115612.png | assets/2026-11-18_tanker-markets-at-two-chokepoints_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_7e24f08c81cb.png
This week's Allied Quantumsea Research reviews the extension of the US Jones Act waiver alongside the latest maritime-security and vessel-crossing developments at Bab el-Mandeb and the Strait of Hormuz. Executive assessment
Two distinct constraints continue to influence tanker freight markets. In the United States, the renewed Jones Act waiver permits selected foreign-flag coastwise shipments subject to voyage-specific clearance.
